prompt: Write a Python class `LRUCache` with a constructor `__init__(self, capacity: int)`, a method `get(self, key) -> int` returning the value or -1 if not present, and a method `put(self, key, value) -> None` that evicts the least-recently-used entry when inserting would exceed capacity. Accessing a key via get() or put() counts as a use. Return ONLY a single Python code fence with the class definition, no explanation.
test_code:
from solution import LRUCache

def test_basic_get_put():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 100)
    cache.put(2, 200)
    assert cache.get(1) == 100

def test_eviction_of_least_recently_used():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 100)
    cache.put(2, 200)
    cache.get(1)          # 1 is now most-recently-used
    cache.put(3, 300)     # evicts 2, not 1
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(1) == 100
    assert cache.get(3) == 300

def test_put_updates_existing_key_and_recency():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 100)
    cache.put(2, 200)
    cache.put(1, 999)     # updates value, 1 is now most-recently-used
    cache.put(3, 300)     # evicts 2
    assert cache.get(1) == 999
    assert cache.get(2) == -1

def test_missing_key_returns_negative_one():
    cache = LRUCache(1)
    assert cache.get(42) == -1
